Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that streams microphone audio and yields interim transcripts using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 2 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 3 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 4 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 5 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 6 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import asyncio
import os
import queue
import threading
from typing import AsyncIterator, Optional

import pyaudio
from deepgram import DeepgramClient, LiveOptions, LiveTranscriptionEvents


class DeepgramMicStreamer:
    def __init__(
        self,
        sample_rate: int = 16000,
        channels: int = 1,
        chunk_size: int = 1024,
        model: str = "nova-2",
        language: str = "en-US",
        interim_results: bool = True,
        endpointing: Optional[int] = 300,
    ) -> None:
        api_key = os.environ["DEEPGRAM_API_KEY"]
        self.client = DeepgramClient(api_key)

        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
        self.channels = channels
        self.chunk_size = chunk_size
        self.model = model
        self.language = language
        self.interim_results = interim_results
        self.endpointing = endpointing

        self._audio = None
        self._stream = None
        self._conn = None
        self._transcript_queue: "queue.Queue[str]" = queue.Queue()
        self._stop_event = threading.Event()
        self._loop: Optional[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop] = None

    def _on_transcript(self, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
        result = None
        for arg in args:
            if hasattr(arg, "channel"):
                result = arg
                break
        if result is None:
            result = kwargs.get("result")
        if result is None:
            return

        try:
            alternatives = result.channel.alternatives
            if not alternatives:
                return
            transcript = alternatives[0].transcript.strip()
            if transcript:
                self._transcript_queue.put(transcript)
        except Exception:
            return

    def _on_error(self, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
        error = None
        if args:
            error = args[-1]
        elif "error" in kwargs:
            error = kwargs["error"]
        self._transcript_queue.put(f"ERROR: {error}")
        self._stop_event.set()

    def _open_microphone(self) -> None:
        self._audio = pyaudio.PyAudio()
        self._stream = self._audio.open(
            format=pyaudio.paInt16,
            channels=self.channels,
            rate=self.sample_rate,
            input=True,
            frames_per_buffer=self.chunk_size,
        )

    def _close_microphone(self) -> None:
        if self._stream is not None:
            try:
                self._stream.stop_stream()
            except Exception:
                pass
            try:
                self._stream.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._stream = None
        if self._audio is not None:
            try:
                self._audio.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._audio = None

    async def transcripts(self) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
        self._loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        self._stop_event.clear()

        self._conn = self.client.listen.websocket.v("1")
        self._conn.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, self._on_transcript)
        self._conn.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Error, self._on_error)

        options = LiveOptions(
            model=self.model,
            language=self.language,
            encoding="linear16",
            channels=self.channels,
            sample_rate=self.sample_rate,
            interim_results=self.interim_results,
            endpointing=self.endpointing,
            smart_format=True,
            punctuate=True,
        )

        started = self._conn.start(options)
        if not started:
            raise RuntimeError("Failed to start Deepgram streaming connection")

        self._open_microphone()

        async def pump_audio() -> None:
            try:
                while not self._stop_event.is_set():
                    data = await asyncio.to_thread(
                        self._stream.read,
                        self.chunk_size,
                        False,
                    )
                    if data:
                        self._conn.send(data)
            finally:
                try:
                    self._conn.finish()
                except Exception:
                    pass

        pump_task = asyncio.create_task(pump_audio())

        try:
            while not self._stop_event.is_set():
                try:
                    item = await asyncio.to_thread(self._transcript_queue.get, True, 0.1)
                    yield item
                except queue.Empty:
                    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        finally:
            self._stop_event.set()
            pump_task.cancel()
            try:
                await pump_task
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._close_microphone()
            if self._conn is not None:
                try:
                    self._conn.finish()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self._conn = None


async def stream_microphone_transcripts() -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    streamer = DeepgramMicStreamer()
    async for transcript in streamer.transcripts():
        yield transcript
